name: Nijel's Point
summary: Alliance soldiers and Cenarion druids hold Nijel's Point above Desolace's harsh wastes. The outpost shelters travelers, researchers, and soldiers crossing the blighted valleys below.

sections.title: A Bastion Above the Wastes
sections.body:
Nijel's Point clings to cliffs along the Stonetalon Mountains, high above Desolace's gray dust and marauding centaur packs. Captain Pentigast commands a Stormwind Army detachment there. His soldiers watch the clan wars that threaten Alliance interests across southern Kalimdor. High cliffs and narrow trails make the outpost easy to defend.

Couriers, scouts, and griffin riders use Nijel's Point as a staging ground on routes between Stonetalon Peak, Theramore, and Feathermoon Stronghold.

sections.title: Cenarion and Crusade Expeditions
sections.body: Stormwind soldiers share Nijel's Point with emissaries whose work takes them into danger. Keeper Marandis and his dryads use the camp as a base to confront Princess Theradras deep within Maraudon and recover the fallen demigod Zaetar. Brother Anton, an emissary of the Scarlet Crusade, seeks to scour the undead ravaging the valley floor. Even among the soldiers and druids on the ridge, Nijel's identity remains an ancient mystery.

faq.q: Why is the Alliance stationed in Desolace?
faq.answer: Captain Pentigast leads a Stormwind Army detachment to watch the warring centaur clans. The Alliance fears that if one clan wipes out the others, the victors will turn against nearby territories and settlements such as Stonetalon and Feralas.

aliases: who was nijels point named after
faq.answer: No one at the outpost seems to know who Nijel was. His history has been lost to time.

faq.q: What is the Cenarion Circle doing at Nijel's Point?
faq.answer: Keeper Marandis and his dryad sisters came to Desolace to purge Maraudon, slay Princess Theradras, and reclaim Zaetar's remains for the sacred groves of the Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.q: Why is the Scarlet Crusade at Nijel's Point?
faq.answer: Brother Anton is a distant emissary of the Scarlet Crusade. Brother Crowley in Stormwind sends Alliance adventurers to him, where he tests their resolve against the undead ravagers in Desolace's Valley of Bones.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you can use Nijel's Point as your sole fortified refuge and flight staging ground in Desolace. It links supply lines between Stonetalon, Theramore, and Feralas.
As a druid, you can see Keeper Marandis use this mountain sanctuary to organize the recovery of Zaetar's remains from the corruption within Maraudon.
